THE FEDERAL COURT ACT, 1937
ACT NO. XXV OF 1937
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see

[7th October, 1937]
An Act to empower the Federal Court to make rules for regulating the
service of processes issued by the Court
1. Short title. This Act may be called the Federal Court Act, 1937.

Power of Supreme Court to make rules
